content.introduction: On October 5, 2026, Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi delivered her policy speech during a plenary session of the House of Representatives. The Nikkei average briefly regained the 70,000 mark as optimism around AI returned, taking Tokyo stocks to a three-month intraday high. The Bank of Japan Governor Kazuo Ueda highlighted interest rates, bank lending, and asset markets as factors the central bank will monitor for further rate hikes. The September U.S. jobs report showed slower-than-expected growth, prompting investors to reduce bets on a Federal Reserve rate hike this month.
